nodes.name: mcp__evimed__evidence_pool
nodes.description: Pool this study's verified extractions of one parameter into an assumption distribution on the 虚拟临床研究 engine (DL / REML / HKSJ random effects or a fixed effect, with a prediction interval). Name the parameter and the endpoint definition it is measured under -- the values pooled are the ones the study already holds, checked against their source, never numbers you bring. start returns a jobId (or says why nothing was started: no verified evidence, no such parameter) and lists every study it left out with the reason (refused); status reports the pooled estimate, heterogeneity and the prediction interval. Never average the numbers yourself.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__kb_browse
nodes.description: Find your way through the researcher's knowledge base when a question spans several documents or asks what it holds: op=overview gives the wiki's table of contents (root wiki), the graph's counts (kg) or the documents by title (sources, library); list and tree a directory; read a page or a document by lines; grep the lines holding a text. For a passage to quote use kb_search; a question that needs no knowledge base needs no tool.

root.description: wiki, kg: compiled pages and graph; sources: this project's documents; library: the cross-project ones.

path.description: Relative to the root, as a listing or a page link gives it. read needs one.

limit.description: read: lines (default 200); list: entries (default 100, at most 200).

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__kb_search
nodes.description: Search the researcher's own knowledge base (this project's uploaded documents and their personal library) for passages. Answers with quotable snippets, the document, page and character offsets; a small library is answered with the files to read instead.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__literature_search
nodes.description: Search the biomedical and scientific literature (PubMed and the other configured sources) through the EviMed evidence adapter. Supply `relation` instead to retrieve the literature PubTator3 records a relation in — papers that assert the relation, not papers where both terms merely co-occur; get the concept identifiers from term_normalize. Supply `pmids` instead to fetch the abstracts, publication types and MeSH headings of PubMed records you have screened in (up to 200); each abstract is preserved and quotable. Public results are bibliographic metadata unless abstract or full-text fields are explicitly present; never infer study design, evidence level, outcomes, or effect estimates from a title.

offset.description: PubMed route: results to skip. data.outcome says when more exist and what to pass.

articleTypes.description: EviMed's own study-type labels, e.g. 随机对照试验 for randomized controlled trials.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__locate_quote
nodes.description: Find a quotation in a source this run preserved, judged exactly as the delivery gate judges a claim's supportQuote (case, quotation marks, dashes, whitespace, full-width forms, CJK spacing, PDF line breaks, inline citation markers and marked … elisions are forgiven; anything else is not). found=true only for a match the gate accepts; each match has character offsets into the preserved file, its line and context. When not found, match=near passages show what the source actually says, to quote instead. Read-only.

sourceId.description: The .evimed-sources/... path a preserving tool returned, or the id it reported (PMCID, DOI, web-page:<hash>, EVIMED-GUIDE:<id>, label:<approval number>#<section>).

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__open_access_full_text
nodes.description: Resolve a PMCID, PMID or DOI through Europe PMC and preserve the open-access full text (publisher JATS XML, else the open-access PDF) with its tables as cells, its PMC version and its license. data.contentLevel says what the text is; an abstract is never full text. supplements=true also fetches the article's supplementary files, checks each against the md5 the article declares and preserves them (up to ~150 s; a cut-short archive keeps the files that arrived whole). intake=true hands the text and supplements to the project's knowledge base. Refusals, timeouts and no-supplement answers are named in data.outcome and data.supplementaryFiles.

supplements.description: Default false. Fetch and preserve the supplementary files.

intake.description: Default false. Offer the preserved text and supplements to the knowledge base.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__term_normalize
nodes.description: Normalize a medical term using a deterministic bilingual vocabulary. Deterministic and offline by default; set annotate to also look the term up in PubTator3 and return its concept identifiers, which is what a relation query in literature_search is addressed with. An annotation is an identifier, not a normalization. Set mesh to map an English term to its MeSH descriptor: entry terms, tree numbers, narrower descriptors and a PubMed query that searches them.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__trial_registry_record
nodes.description: Fetch one trial-registry record as structured fields: PICO, design, arms, planned and actual enrolment with their dates, sites, the eligibility text as written, endpoints and published results. Planned and actual enrolment are kept apart -- the gap between them is the most useful accrual prior there is.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__vcr_read
nodes.description: Read the current conversation's research objects and evidence. what=study gives task context; subject_document reads original patient material through existing permission and quote checks. matching filter.kind=contract returns write syntax; filter.subjectKey plus filter.id reads one criterion without repeated schemas. matching and candidate_trials retain criterion evidence and unknowns; filter.subjectKey selects a platform pseudonym. No invented eligibility or clinical validity. Use the virtual clinical research skill for details.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__vcr_simulate
nodes.description: Run a bounded research calculation on the current conversation's objects: start, status, cancel. action shape and kind return the exact method scenario and examples: never guess a key; invalid input is refused by the field's path. Inputs kind:'snapshot' name owned data; the vcr-analysis skill describes the workflow. Start returns a durable job; a long job continues in this same conversation when it finishes. Failure, cancellation and partial results stay explicit. modelId requires immutable modelVersion. Narrow aggregate calculations also use research_calculate without a study.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__vcr_write
nodes.description: Save research objects in this conversation. what=task_context opens an independent task context; patient_context data={messageSeq?} preserves an authenticated human message, or data={sourceId} an owned uploaded original. It accepts no patient prose from the model. Preserve sourced quotes and use the returned subjectKey/documentId for facts and trial matching. candidate_trial stores registry-linked eligibility. Other objects use their structured contract; computed results are never writable. For numerical configuration use vcr_simulate action shape with design_analytic, design_simulation, generate_patients, generate_patients_continuous, generate_patients_binary or generate_population.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.

nodes.name: mcp__evimed__web_read
nodes.description: Read one public web page or online document (HTML, PDF, office file) through the platform gateway and preserve it in the workspace as a snapshot with a sha256 receipt. The page itself can be the primary source: an official site, documentation, a release note, a policy text. Long text comes in pages: pass page=N for the next one (nextPage says whether there is one). Pages from regulators, guideline bodies and trial registries are marked official.

outputSchema.note: MCP publishes no output schema for this tool; these are the result fields an edge may depend on.
